description: Angular component for a counter page utilizing NgRx store for state management, displaying counter value, positivity status, and controls for increment, decrement, reset, and async increment actions.

classes.name: CounterPageComponent
classes.description: Angular standalone component displaying a counter with controls, subscribing to NgRx store selectors for current value and positivity status, and dispatching actions based on user interactions.

methods.name: onIncrement
methods.description: Dispatches the increment action to the store.

methods.name: onDecrement
methods.description: Dispatches the decrement action to the store.

methods.name: onReset
methods.description: Dispatches the reset action to the store.

methods.name: onIncrementAsync
methods.description: Dispatches the incrementAsync action with a default delay of 600ms.
